title: project_window_mean never reads `remaining`: the peak guard weights the live draw by elapsed time
claim: power_guard.project_window_mean stores `remaining = window_minutes - elapsed` and returns (mean * elapsed + current_kw * elapsed) / window_minutes, so a constant 4 kW draw projects 0.0 kW at the window's start, 0.67 kW at minute 5 and 8.0 kW at minute 60 instead of 4.0 kW throughout.
mechanism: The dead local is the term the formula needs: the remainder of the window is assumed to continue at current_kw, i.e. current_kw * remaining. With `elapsed` in its place the projection under-reads for the first half of every metering window (the guard cannot suppress electric DHW before the peak is booked) and over-reads in the second half (it suppresses on a draw that is under the threshold). The docstring's own two limits fail: 'at the window's start this is the current draw' reads 0, 'at its end it converges on the realised average' reads mean + current. Caller: coordinator.py:8794, whose result is GuardState.update's projection_kw against the capacity-tariff threshold.

evidence.unit: probes of 8 on which a constant 4 kW draw does not project 4 kW (minutes 0, 5, 15, 45, 55, 60 and the no-samples case; minute 30 agrees because elapsed and remaining are equal there)
evidence.machine: Apple M1 (8 cores), Darwin 27.2.0 arm64, Python 3.14.7 (venv-ci)
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out, load1 150-270; the number is a static or behavioural count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: attribute swap of power_guard.project_window_mean for the same body with `current_kw * (window_minutes - elapsed)` (m8_agree.py --only window_mean --perturb); the static twin: m6_inner.py's unread_local row power_guard.py:64 leaves the census

metric_definition: probes (elapsed minute of a 60 min window) at which project_window_mean(4.0, elapsed, 4.0, 60) != 4.0, plus the mean_so_far=None case
phenomenon_property: Every local a production function stores is loaded on a path to its return value or a side effect; a stored-and-never-read local in arithmetic code is a term dropped from the formula until shown otherwise.

null_control.note: the probe at minute 30 (elapsed and remaining are both 30) agrees in the same run: the one point of the window where the dropped term cannot show; the other seven unread locals of the census (coordinator.py:3121 i, coordinator.py:6619 done, optimizer.py:1212 solar, sysid.py:1977 rank1, sysid.py:2109 residuals, sysid.py:2322 outdoors and powers) are unpacking targets with no dropped term

proposed_fix_scope: power_guard.py:project_window_mean reads `remaining`; the structure ratchet could carry an unread-local count (tests/structure.py has none).
